Asha (CS): Week0 quick pulse for Sunward private/VPC onboarding. Network and IAM smoke good. Two open items blocking go-live: audit events arriving without sessionContext fields, and KMS rotation failing due to alias mismatch. Tagging @Kai and @Liam to triage.

Kai (Platform): Can you paste a redacted example and the exact rotation error so I can reproduce?

Asha (CS): Redacted log line: eventTime=2026-02-26T10:04:12Z eventName=StartInstances userIdentity=AssumedRole arn:arn:aws:sts::111111111111:assumed-role/SunwardCross/DeployRole (sessionContext missing). Rotation error: "Error: KMS alias \"alias/sunward-prod-enc\" not found" but actual alias present is alias/sunward-prod-enc-2025.

Liam (Security): Likely causes: CloudTrail configured without management events or the log-forwarder strips nested fields. I'll check CloudTrail includeManagementEvents and the delivery role trust today.

DeployBot: smoke-runner: 1788880012 | checks: network:ok iam:ok kms:fail audit:fail | artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/sunward/week0/1788880012

Asha (CS): Proposed plan: (1) Kai to make rotation script tolerant to suffixed aliases and add a preflight validation; (2) Liam to validate trail/delivery pipeline and update onboarding runbook to require sessionContext passthrough if needed; (3) If both not cleared by Fri EOW mark medium renewal risk and schedule remediation call.

Kai (Platform): I'll push a small patch and unit test by EOD and update the runbook snippet.

Liam (Security): I'll confirm trail + forwarder behavior and share remediation steps by tomorrow noon.

Asha (CS): Scheduling 30m sync tomorrow 10:00 PT to review fixes. I'll DM Sunward ops a short summary and request temporary read-only log access if needed. Tagging this thread as week0-health and adding Sunward to renewal-watch until cleared.
